summary.prose: Build incremental review visibility on the existing activity and checkpoint infrastructure. Keep progress bounded, truthful and separate from review judgments, then expose a read-only polling helper with concise user updates.

tasks.title: Define bounded progress contracts and truthful projection
tasks.summary: Add optional attempt progress schema and bounded sanitized reducer; normalize phase/task/count, monotonic elapsed, meaningful activity and explicit freshness. Existing checkpoint without metadata remains unknown.
acceptanceChecks: Optional bounded metadata accepts old checkpoints without fabricating activity
No raw model output,commands,tool IDs or reasoning persisted; phase remains unknown/generic without evidence

tests.name: Projects sanitized bounded phases and meaningful activity with unknown-safe elapsed
Reads checkpoints with optional progress and rejects malformed metadata

tasks.title: Serialize coalesced progress persistence with task results
tasks.summary: Reuse per-review serial writer; latest-only coalescing,5sec routine writes, immediate boundary flush, generation fencing and timer disposal. Never overwrite newer results or input; progress write failure is best effort while task-result failure remains fail-stop. At most one pending progress flush, including rapid phase changes; serial task/result boundaries remain authoritative.
acceptanceChecks: High-rate events retain one pending snapshot; routine writes bounded to5sec
Late queued writes cannot overwrite task results; timer stopped on retirement; failures retain last durable observation
Rapid phase alternation cannot create an unbounded write queue

tests.name: Coalesces progress writes and fences stale generations without corrupting results
Retains durable feedback when progress persistence fails

tasks.title: Connect daemon and controller execution observations
tasks.summary: Feed accepted activity-v1 observations and lifecycle transitions from both reviewer routes. Distinguish generic tools, trustworthy test observations and process liveness; preserve30min inactivity and explicit controller retrigger.
acceptanceChecks: Both routes expose task/phase/count and real activity with generation isolation
Heartbeat/polls do not renew activity; long tools tracked honestly; completed feedback authoritative

tests.name: Daemon and controller produce equivalent progress without renewing inactivity on heartbeat
Terminal task result supersedes pending progress and stops timers

tasks.title: Expose read-only progress and deterministic user updates
tasks.summary: Add validated codeReview.task.progress delegation and deterministic formatter/poll guidance:5sec reads, immediate changes/terminal errors and45sec ongoing updates. No execution restart, provider calls or normal MCP migration. Include a cancellable explicit task-review polling helper using existing IPC client, injectable clock and update callback; controller can use this without retired endpoints.
acceptanceChecks: Read validates project/review/attempt and does not invoke provider/resume
User sees immediate changes and45sec updates; stale/unknown explicit; no percentage estimates
Concrete helper emits updates via callback, cancels cleanly and never retriggers review

tests.name: Read-only progress IPC validates scope and never invokes providers
Polling helper emits immediate transitions and45sec updates and cancels cleanly

tasks.title: Verify progress across native adapters, reconnect and failure
tasks.summary: Use existing fake CLI/production IPC fixtures for both providers; prove isolated reviews, stale restart/reconnect, no extra calls, bounded writes and races. Document use and limits; no full expensive review loop.
acceptanceChecks: Both native fixtures and real IPC prove end-to-end behavior with zero hosted-model calls
Reconnect,write-failure,terminal race and concurrent review isolation covered; document matching-version recovery limits

tests.name: Both native CLI fixtures expose isolated reconnectable progress through production IPC
Progress write failure restart and terminal races preserve authoritative task outcomes

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Both native adapter fixtures through task-review IPC
